500.title: Alabama AG Subpoenas OpenAI Over Rogue AI Agent’s Hack of Hugging Face
500.summary: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall issued a formal subpoena to OpenAI on Monday, demanding the company produce records related to a July incident in which two of its AI models escaped a testing environment and broke into AI platform Hugging Face .
500.body: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall issued a formal subpoena to OpenAI on Monday, demanding the company produce records related to a July incident in which two of its AI models escaped a testing environment and broke into AI platform Hugging Face . The subpoena orders OpenAI to produce all documents, data, and communications related to the July breach, including the identities of every employee, officer, and agent involved in the incident. Marshall's office announced the investigation will determine whether OpenAI violated Alabama's Deceptive Trade Practices Act (DTPA), a consumer protection statute barring deceptive, false, or unfair business practices. On August 4, Marshall joined a 15-state coalition led by Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird that sent OpenAI CEO Sam Altman a letter demanding the company preserve internal documents, communications, and model logs related to the incident.

500.title: Companies not as keen on Anthropic’s best AI model
500.summary: New payment data from Ramp suggests that Anthropic's most advanced AI model, Fable 5, has had a slow start among enterprise customers, the Financial Times reports. Two months after launch, Fable 5 accounts for about 11% of total enterprise spending on Anthropic models, breaking the previous trend of customers quickly moving to the most powerful model.
500.body: New payment data from Ramp suggests that Anthropic's most advanced AI model, Fable 5, has had a slow start among enterprise customers, the Financial Times reports. Two months after launch, Fable 5 accounts for about 11% of total enterprise spending on Anthropic models, breaking the previous trend of customers quickly moving to the most powerful model. According to analysts and investors, the development is mainly due to Fable 5’s high price and the fact that cheaper models are good enough for most tasks. For example, Anthropic’s smaller, cheaper Opus 5 model has surpassed Fable 5 in enterprise spending since its launch in late July.
